options.text: He said my dog died on a cold night.

• The given sentence is in **Simple Past Tense**.
 
• The rule for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The **tense** of **reported speech** is changed only when the **reporting verb** is in the **past tense**. 
 
• **Simple Past Tense** changes to **Past Perfect**** Tense**.
 
• The reporting verb **said **will remain the same.
 
• We must remove the inverted commas from the direct speech and replace them with an appropriate conjunction.
 
• The reported speech needs to change the possessive pronoun "my" to "his" since it refers to the speaker's dog and not the listener's.
 
• The verb** "died"** needs to be changed to "had died" to reflect that it happened before the time of reporting.
 
• The second person of direct speech changes as per the object of the reporting speech.
 
• Structure__**: (Subject+ V2 + object) (Direct Speech)**

 ** (Subject+ had + V3 + object) (Indirect Speech)**
 __
 
• ​**Example: **
 
• *She said, " Reena came to see me."* **(Direct Speech)**
 
• *She said that Reena had come to see her.**** *(Indirect Speech)**
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__ ***He said his dog had died on a cold night.*
